# Subway Seat for matplotlib

Charts on the walnut (or enamel) ground with parchment labels, quiet grid lines, and a color cycle that alternates warm and cool so neighboring series stay apart: burnt orange, seafoam, harvest gold, denim, redbird, avocado, terracotta. Saved figures keep the ground color.

[matplotlib](https://matplotlib.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/matplotlib/) · Needs matplotlib 3.4+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your notebook or script:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.style.use("subway-seat")
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your notebook or script:

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.style.use("subway-seat-tunnel")
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your notebook or script:

```python
plt.style.use("subway-seat-enamel")
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-tunnel.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/subway-seat-enamel.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/london-moquette.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/london-deep-level.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/london-portland.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/paris-guimard.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/paris-catacombes.mplstyle`.
- Delete `~/.matplotlib/stylelib/paris-carrelage.mplstyle`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
